item.description: M.S. student in Machine Learning · Carnegie Mellon University I am a master’s student in the Machine Learning Department at Carnegie Mellon University, where I worked with Prof. Andrea Zanette on harnesses in which frontier models write low-level robot skills as code. Formerly, I was a research assistant in the Embodied AI Lab at National Taiwan University working with Prof. Tsung-Wei Ke on LLM agents that seek information before they plan, and on reinforcement learning fine-tuning of vision-language-action models.

item.title: Research
item.description: My work focuses on LLM agents and robot learning. Much of it aims at getting foundation models to act reliably in the physical world, where an agent has incomplete information and its assumptions about the world can be wrong. To these ends, I have worked on harnesses in which frontier models write robot control code, information-seeking LLM planners, and RL fine-tuning of vision-language-action models.
